sources.snippet: The base gemma-2b is a raw language model without this tuning, requiring you to format prompts in a specific way. For chat and question-answering, use gemma-2b-it; for custom fine-tuning or prompt engineering, the base model may be preferable. Q: How long does inference take on Replicate?

sources.title: gemma-2-2b-it: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview gemma-2-2b-it is a 2-billion parameter instruction-tuned language model developed by google-deepmind. It generates text responses to natural language prompts and is optimized for dialogue and instruction-following tasks.
